notes: THIS MOD HAS NO QUESTABLE CONTENT. Curios API 5.14.1 for 1.20.1 Forge is an accessory SLOT API and registers ZERO items, ZERO blocks and ZERO entities - exactly as the brief suspected. VERIFICATION: 242 jar entries; assets/curios/ contains a lang file and GUI textures but NOT ONE item./block./entity. key - the strict 3-segment scan for item.curios.*, block.curios.* and entity.curios.* returns 0, 0 and 0, and assets/curios/models/item/ and assets/curios/blockstates/ do not exist. LOADER/VERSION CONFIRMED: META-INF/mods.toml (no fabric.mod.json), modId="curios", displayName="Curios API", forge "[46,)", minecraft "[1.20,1.21)". This jar is the copy already installed in the pack's mods folder. WHAT THE MOD ACTUALLY SHIPS: ten slot-type definitions under data/curios/curios/slots/ - back, belt, body, bracelet, charm, curio, hands, head, necklace, ring - plus the GUI, the keybind (key.curios.open.desc) and the /curios add|set|remove|lock|unlock|drop|clear|replace|reset command family. The lang file is entirely UI strings: curios.identifier.* names the ten slots and curios.modifiers.* renders the 'When worn as ring:' tooltip lines on OTHER mods' accessories. NOTHING IS WEARABLE FROM THIS NAMESPACE. Every curio a player can actually obtain belongs to a dependent mod (in this pack that is artifacts, relics, sophisticatedbackpacks, travelersbackpack, ars_nouveau and so on), so all accessory questing has to target those namespaces. A slot only appears in the player's inventory once some other mod's item declares it, which means even 'unlock the ring slot' is not expressible as a curios: id. CONSENSUS: absent from moddb.json - consistent with registering nothing. Do not generate a chapter for this mod.
